question: If I cast Gaze of Justice from my graveyard with flashback, do I still have to pay its additional cost of tapping three untapped white creatures?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the additional cost must be paid when it is cast with flashback.
expected.answer: The additional cost must be paid if Gaze of Justice is cast with flashback.
